note: Route tags classify the kind of record a lead concerns; they are not findings of fact, liability or legal merit. A lead may appear on more than one route. A public-body tag identifies an institutional record or actor only: it is not, by itself, a ground to set aside the 1987 judgment. Any register-rectification or public-body complaint/remedy enquiry is a distinct route requiring its own evidence and legal basis. Route gauges show the highest evidence-held score among tagged leads.

routes.label: Dishonesty
routes.desc: A document, signature or statement relevant to an enquiry into possible dishonesty. The tag is a research category, not a finding that dishonesty occurred.

routes.label: Concealment
routes.desc: A record relevant to an enquiry into possible non-production, non-disclosure or loss. The tag does not establish deliberate concealment.

routes.label: Public bodies
routes.desc: A record made, held or dealt with by a registry, court, council or other public body. This is a separate institutional enquiry route, not a ground to reopen the 1987 judgment on its own.
